close_reason: Fixed: MAINTENANCE comments added; Message/get now respects RFC 8620 §5.1 properties parameter
description:
handle_message_get (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs:17-59) passes None as the properties parameter to backend.get_objects() on line 39, completely ignoring the RFC 8620 §5.1 properties field that clients may send.

When a client sends:
  Message/get { ids: ['m1'], properties: ['id', 'body'] }

They receive all fields instead of the requested subset. This is silent protocol deviation.

Pattern to follow: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mailbox.rs lines 34-67 correctly implements property filtering with filter_properties().

Drift risk: No compile error signals this behavior is missing. A future maintainer may not realize Message/get needs property filtering, leaving the handler incomplete against the spec.

Related: MessageProperty enum (crate-jmap-chat-types/src/backend.rs:65) exists but is unused.
title: Message/get silently ignores RFC 8620 §5.1 properties parameter
